description: Fingerprints of the tested Windows x86 PD2/D2GL files and plugin, with activation and loader settings.
validation: All three Win32 Release suites passed with installed artwork/table/archive fixtures. Entry-wall and blinking corrections and Act 3 bank coloring were confirmed offline. The latest Act 1 raised-bank filename lookup has automated coverage; live confirmation is pending. Broad version coverage and long-session performance remain under test.
gameTables: Automatically read from active installed game archives or direct overrides via native Storm; development fixture hashes are informational, not files to download. Missing/malformed geometry or layer tables retain native/per-area fallback. Missing marker definitions disable the affected shrine/event fallback; existing native drawing remains.
optionalMenuNote: Map Style and the wall/boundary color lists require the profiled expansion menu and runtime layout guards. Unsupported menu layouts retain INI style/color settings.
